subject: Quick update about the order
text:
I checked on the order you mentioned after our lunch conversation. The shipping option changed because the carrier shifted delivery routes for the next two days, so the earlier arrival estimate is no longer reliable. I wanted to let you know quickly since you planned to use the item before the weekend. If the original timing matters, the only practical way to recover time is to switch to express handling tonight, which would add a small surcharge. Otherwise, the standard route should still arrive before Monday, just later than first expected. No action is needed if the later date works, but if you want me to update the shipping preference before the warehouse cutoff, reply soon and I will take care of it. Sorry the change arrived late, and thank you for being flexible.

Best,
